dataset_status: exposed public source cards; not untouched confirmation

lead.2: useful lead for an explicit part of purpose

facet_tags: only visibly supported useful reading leads or supplied substantive information for a named facet; no unseen-content/authority inference
uncertainty: record ambiguous relevance/facet support; source/model claims are not verified facts
binding: EXP-063 complete inventory, exact fingerprint and same-card row/facet anchors
review: two separately shuffled ranking-blind assessments, every card individually; full independent source/rationale/facet audit before model calls
historical_boundary: do not read old refs/model ranks while assessing; no repair/re-score of old acceptance; this prospective set serves only new registered exposed measurements
decision: qualified only after both full 396-row source-bound assessments and full semantic audit; disagreement retained without forced gold consensus
